queries_run: Texas Instruments 10-K 2026 top customer revenue concentration disclosure
Texas Instruments automotive industrial customer inventory destocking credit stress 2026
Texas Instruments Q1 2026 earnings release date April automotive revenue "797 million"

findings.claim: TXN FY2025 Form 10-K (filed with SEC 2026-02-06) discloses TI sells to over 100,000 customers, with roughly half of total revenue coming from customers outside its top 50 — i.e. no material single-customer or small-group revenue concentration disclosed.
findings.source: Texas Instruments FY2025 Form 10-K, SEC EDGAR (filed 2026-02-06)

findings.claim: TI's FY2025 10-K states more than 80% of 2025 revenue was direct (including TI.com), a continued shift away from distributor-based sales that increases TI's visibility into true end-customer demand and reduces distributor-channel inventory opacity.
findings.source: Texas Instruments FY2025 Form 10-K, SEC EDGAR

findings.claim: TI Q1 2026 results (reported 2026-04-22): automotive revenue grew ~5% YoY to approximately $797M, the first YoY automotive growth after seven consecutive quarters of decline; management attributed the inflection to completed customer destocking and low customer inventory levels across auto/industrial end markets.
findings.source: TI Q1 2026 earnings release and earnings call, investor.ti.com

findings.claim: TI management cautioned in Q1 2026 commentary that customer inventory depletion appears complete but 'any renewed economic weakness could trigger another destocking phase' — i.e. end-customer macro-demand risk (not a TI-specific customer credit event) has not been eliminated.
findings.source: TI Q1 2026 earnings commentary (Yahoo Finance / Globe and Mail republication of TI investor materials)
